name: quanta-costa
description: Quanta Costa: your Claude subscription period, weekly limit with a pace forecast, session cost and plan value, as bars right above the Claude Code prompt.

billingDay.title: Billing day
billingDay.description: Day of the month your Claude subscription renews (1 to 31). It is on your Anthropic receipt. 0 hides the Period row.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Show costs in US dollars or euros.

eurRate.title: USD to EUR rate
eurRate.description: Euros per US dollar, used when currency is EUR. Default: ECB rate of 2026-10-09.

planPrice.title: Plan price
planPrice.description: What your Claude plan costs per month, in the currency you show (as on your receipt). Turns on the Value row: API value of this period against your plan. 0 hides it.
